about_the_game:
A head-to-head strategy "board" game played on a grid of face-up standard playing cards. Easy to learn and play, but very difficult to master. Luck will help you very little - the better player always wins. Play against eight computer opponents of varying challenge levels, or play against a human opponent in-person or via Steam's Remote Play Together. Compatible with mouse and touchscreen devices - touch-friendly.

RULES, GUIDE, EXAMPLES and TIPS are available in-game via the RULES button.

TWO NEWLY ADDED PLAYING MODES:

2 TIMED GAMES mode. 2 consecutive games played on the same cards each game, but alternating who goes first. Turns have a 30 second countdown timer.  The truest test in the game.

QUESO-BOT CHALLENGE! single player mode. When playing in the most difficult single player configuration (Player 1 = QUESO-BOT; Player 2 = HUMAN; Grid = 6x5) the game will track your win streak and provide customized feedback based on your performance.
